Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vihaan - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Aditi - 11 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Sunita - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Aditi stand near him.]

Sunita: "Vihaan, what's the plan today?"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Sunita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Flower petals rain down on Vihaan.]

Aditi (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Vihaan: "Yes, all right."

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Vihaan: "Exactly right."

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Vihaan: "Exactly right."

[Vihaan lights a bonfire.]

Vihaan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Aditi and Sunita stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Aditi, look over here."

[Vihaan puts on his school uniform.]

Vihaan: "This is amazing!"

[Aditi applies kajal to her eyes.]

Aditi: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aditi puts on red lipstick.]

Vihaan: "I'm ready!"

[Aditi puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Sunita: "I'm ready!"

[Vihaan reads a storybook.]

Aditi (excited): "Vihaan, listen!"

[Vihaan writes in his notebook.]

Vihaan (gently): "Yes, all right."

[Vihaan opens the window.]

Vihaan (happily): "Aditi, look at this."

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Vihaan stands in the kitchen. Sunita stands near him.]

Vihaan: "Let's begin."

[Vihaan makes tea for everyone.]

Vihaan: "What next?"

[Vihaan chops onions for the curry.]

Vihaan (surprised): "Really?"

[Vihaan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Vihaan: "What a day to remember!"
